_comment: Issue #421 M4: the FIRST live canonical for combat-context [Dangersense]. data/skills.json gives the skill contexts [combat, exploration] and one effect id for both; #413 gave the exploration half two canonicals and left the combat half covered by data pins alone. In combat the skill is the reason a telegraphed [Slam] paints its blast footprint on the board: combat_playback captures `_ui.dangersense` at ENQUEUE time off the fielded pc's own skill list and the windup_danger terrain overlay is applied ONLY when that read is true. So the pinned pair here is the sim beat (windup_declared, side_vault_construct/slam, exact cells) and its rendering confirmation (ui_terrain_rendered kind=windup_danger over the SAME cells). CAN-FAIL: that ui_terrain_rendered pin is the holder gate itself -- delete or invert the dangersense read in combat_playback.gd, or drop the skill from the build, and this script reds while the fight still resolves identically. The always-paint mutation is the complementary case and is already refereed at unit level by test_combat_visuals' false/true windup pair.

steps._comment: PASSIVE, both halves: held and doing work, yet never a field-hotbar cast (the [Even Footing] schema this skill was authored against).
Bump-move into the guard's cell to set facing off a real blocked move (the walkthroughs' idiom), then commit.
The holder read the combat overlay is gated on, taken from the FIELDED combatant rather than from the fixture -- an Infiltrator holds [Dangersense] by inheritance from the Rogue ladder's L4 grant.
THE SIM BEAT: the construct spends a round gathering, and the payload freezes the 3x3 footprint the blow will land on.

THE DANGERSENSE HALF: the same nine cells painted on the board, under the windup_danger kind board_renderer reserves for this skill. A non-holder gets the feed line and the caster flash and NOTHING here.
Issue #76's telegraph tell rides the same beat -- proves the windup actually played rather than being inferred from a payload.
